scripts.label: Medicine
scripts.title: Routine referral
scripts.text: Dear Dr Green, I am writing to refer Mr Adam Lee for routine review of a persistent cough. He has had symptoms for three weeks and remains clinically stable. I would appreciate your assessment and advice.

scripts.label: Medicine
scripts.title: Urgent referral
scripts.text: Dear Cardiologist, I am writing to urgently refer Ms Sara Khan who developed chest pain and shortness of breath today. Please assess her as soon as possible. Thank you for your urgent review.

scripts.label: Medicine
scripts.title: Discharge / follow-up
scripts.text: Dear Dr Brown, Mr Omar Ali was discharged today following treatment for pneumonia. He is improving and will continue oral antibiotics for five days. Please review him in one week and monitor his recovery.

scripts.label: Nursing
scripts.title: Routine handover
scripts.text: Dear Community Nurse, I am writing to hand over Ms Lina Noor for ongoing wound care at home. Her condition is stable and the dressing should be changed every two days. Please continue routine monitoring.

scripts.label: Nursing
scripts.title: Urgent escalation
scripts.text: Dear Medical Team, Mr John Miles has developed increasing breathlessness and dizziness this morning. His symptoms are worse than yesterday. Please review him urgently and advise on further management.

scripts.label: Nursing
scripts.title: Discharge handover
scripts.text: Dear District Nurse, Ms Huda Salem is being discharged today after treatment for cellulitis. Please continue wound observation and medication support at home and contact the medical team if her condition worsens.

scripts.label: Dentistry
scripts.title: Routine referral
scripts.text: Dear Dental Specialist, I am referring Mr Peter Cole for assessment of persistent jaw discomfort. His symptoms have continued for several weeks without acute swelling. I would appreciate your review and management advice.

scripts.label: Dentistry
scripts.title: Urgent dental problem
scripts.text: Dear Oral Surgery Team, Ms Emma Reed has severe dental pain with new facial swelling since this morning. She is finding it difficult to eat. Please assess her urgently today.

scripts.label: Dentistry
scripts.title: Post-treatment follow-up
scripts.text: Dear Dentist, Mr Ali Hassan is recovering after extraction and reports mild discomfort only. Please review healing at his follow-up appointment and advise if any further treatment is required.

scripts.label: Pharmacy
scripts.title: Routine medication review
scripts.text: Dear Pharmacist, I am referring Ms Nora Kim for a routine medication review because she is taking several long-term medicines and is unsure about the dosing schedule. Please review her medicines and provide counselling.

scripts.label: Pharmacy
scripts.title: Urgent medication issue
scripts.text: Dear Medical Team, Mr David Ross may have taken an incorrect dose of his anticoagulant this morning and now reports dizziness. Please review him urgently and confirm the safest medication plan.

scripts.label: Pharmacy
scripts.title: Discharge medicines
scripts.text: Dear Community Pharmacist, Ms Reem Ali was discharged today with changes to her regular medicines. Please reconcile the new list with her previous medicines and reinforce the updated dosing instructions.

scripts.label: Physiotherapy
scripts.title: Routine assessment
scripts.text: Dear Physiotherapist, I am referring Mr Samir Nabil for assessment of ongoing knee pain and reduced walking tolerance. He remains independently mobile but struggles with stairs. Please assess and provide an appropriate exercise plan.

scripts.label: Physiotherapy
scripts.title: Urgent functional concern
scripts.text: Dear Physiotherapy Team, Ms Helen Ward has had a sudden decline in mobility today and now requires assistance to transfer safely. Please assess her urgently for mobility and falls risk.

scripts.label: Physiotherapy
scripts.title: Discharge rehabilitation
scripts.text: Dear Community Physiotherapist, Mr Kareem Saleh is being discharged after hip surgery. He can mobilise with a frame and has been given basic exercises. Please continue rehabilitation and progress mobility as appropriate.

scripts.label: Radiography
scripts.title: Routine imaging
scripts.text: Dear Imaging Department, I am referring Ms Anna Ford for routine imaging to investigate persistent shoulder pain. Symptoms have continued despite simple treatment. Please arrange the requested examination and report the findings.

scripts.label: Radiography
scripts.title: Urgent imaging
scripts.text: Dear Radiology Team, Mr Luke Evans has acute abdominal pain with worsening tenderness today. Urgent imaging has been requested to clarify the cause. Please assess and perform the appropriate examination as soon as possible.

scripts.label: Radiography
scripts.title: Post-procedure follow-up
scripts.text: Dear Referring Clinician, Ms Maya Chen completed her imaging procedure today without immediate complication. Please review the report when available and arrange any further management required.

scripts.label: Dietetics
scripts.title: Routine nutrition review
scripts.text: Dear Dietitian, I am referring Mr Daniel King for routine nutritional assessment because of gradual weight loss and reduced appetite. He remains medically stable. Please assess his intake and provide a suitable nutrition plan.

scripts.label: Dietetics
scripts.title: Urgent nutritional risk
scripts.text: Dear Dietetics Team, Ms Farah Noor has had very poor oral intake for several days and is becoming weak. Please assess her urgently for nutritional risk and advise on immediate support.

scripts.label: Dietetics
scripts.title: Discharge nutrition plan
scripts.text: Dear Community Dietitian, Mr Owen Price is being discharged with a high-protein meal plan after recent illness. Please review his progress, weight and intake and adjust the plan if needed.

scripts.label: Occupational Therapy
scripts.title: Routine functional assessment
scripts.text: Dear Occupational Therapist, I am referring Ms Lucy Hall for assessment of daily activities and home function. She manages basic self-care but struggles with cooking and shopping. Please assess her needs and recommend suitable support.

scripts.label: Occupational Therapy
scripts.title: Urgent home-safety concern
scripts.text: Dear OT Team, Mr George Malik is due for discharge but is currently unsafe transferring alone and has stairs at home. Please assess him urgently and advise on equipment or support required before discharge.

scripts.label: Occupational Therapy
scripts.title: Discharge / return-home plan
scripts.text: Dear Community OT, Ms Sara Wells is returning home tomorrow after rehabilitation. Please follow up her home setup, equipment use and independence with daily activities and arrange further support if needed.

scripts.label: Optometry
scripts.title: Routine visual review
scripts.text: Dear Optometrist, I am referring Mr James Bell for routine assessment of gradually worsening blurred vision. He has no acute pain or sudden visual loss. Please assess his vision and advise on management.

scripts.label: Optometry
scripts.title: Urgent visual symptoms
scripts.text: Dear Eye Clinic, Ms Nina Patel developed sudden visual disturbance with new flashes and floaters today. Please assess her urgently and advise on further treatment.

scripts.label: Optometry
scripts.title: Post-treatment follow-up
scripts.text: Dear Optometrist, Mr Adam Wells is attending follow-up after recent eye treatment. Symptoms have improved but mild irritation remains. Please review recovery and advise whether further treatment is required.

scripts.label: Podiatry
scripts.title: Routine foot assessment
scripts.text: Dear Podiatrist, I am referring Ms Grace Lee for routine foot assessment because of ongoing callus and discomfort when walking. There is no acute infection. Please assess and provide appropriate foot-care advice.

scripts.label: Podiatry
scripts.title: Urgent wound concern
scripts.text: Dear Podiatry Team, Mr Hassan Ali has a new painful foot wound with increasing redness and swelling. Please assess him urgently for infection and advise on wound management.

scripts.label: Podiatry
scripts.title: Post-procedure follow-up
scripts.text: Dear Podiatrist, Ms Eva Brown is recovering after a minor foot procedure. The wound is dry and pain is improving. Please review healing and advise when normal footwear and activity can resume.

scripts.label: Speech Pathology
scripts.title: Routine communication assessment
scripts.text: Dear Speech Pathologist, I am referring Mr Robert Gray for assessment of ongoing communication difficulty after illness. He can understand conversation but struggles to find words. Please assess and provide an appropriate therapy plan.

scripts.label: Speech Pathology
scripts.title: Urgent swallowing concern
scripts.text: Dear Speech Pathology Team, Ms Amal Noor is coughing repeatedly during meals and has difficulty swallowing fluids today. Please assess her urgently for swallowing safety and advise on suitable intake.

scripts.label: Speech Pathology
scripts.title: Discharge therapy plan
scripts.text: Dear Community Speech Pathologist, Mr Daniel Fox is being discharged after inpatient therapy. His speech has improved but remains slow. Please continue communication therapy and review progress after discharge.

scripts.label: Veterinary Science
scripts.title: Routine referral
scripts.text: Dear Veterinary Specialist, I am referring Max, a six-year-old dog, for routine assessment of persistent skin irritation. He is otherwise active and eating normally. Please assess and advise on further management.

scripts.label: Veterinary Science
scripts.title: Urgent deterioration
scripts.text: Dear Emergency Veterinary Team, Bella has become suddenly lethargic and has vomited several times today. She is not eating and appears uncomfortable. Please assess her urgently.

scripts.label: Veterinary Science
scripts.title: Discharge follow-up
scripts.text: Dear Veterinary Clinic, Milo is being discharged after treatment and is clinically improved. Please review him at follow-up, monitor recovery and advise if any further treatment is needed.
